headline: AI-driven revenue lifts several peers, but overall growth remains modest.
summary: Revenue growth varied widely, with Coforge posting a 53.6% YoY surge while Infosys grew only 1.5%. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, but Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance. AI contributions were highlighted across most firms, yet profit growth lagged at Wipro and Infosys.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Most companies cited AI‑led deals or revenue, driving double‑digit growth in several peers.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; only a few firms raised outlooks.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins rose at TCS (24%) and HCLTech (18.2%) but remained low at OFSS (47.8% due to small base) and fell at Infosys.
